what_this_is: The intended Indianapolis visitor-market geography (the registered ptf-market/1.1 contract) reconciled against the discovery configuration that queries it and the hardened census that resulted. The registered contract was NOT edited: every gap is reported for the founder.

contract.boundary_note: PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-MARKET-BUILD-001. Indianapolis visitor market, not municipal limits and not the entire MSA. Primary core and urban lodging corridors follow Visit Indy neighborhoods and the official IND airport lodging geography. Outer-ring Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville and Westfield are included because Visit Indy lists Hamilton County Tourism as a partner and sells Hamilton County lodging as Indianapolis-north stays; Plainfield, Avon and Brownsburg are included because Visit Hendricks County and the Indianapolis Airport Authority sell them as Indianapolis Airport lodging. Greenwood is included as the I-65 Indianapolis-South commercial lodging cluster. Festival Country Indiana (Franklin, Whiteland, Bargersville) remains a separately sold destination and is excluded. Zionsville, Anderson, Muncie, Bloomington, Columbus IN, Lafayette, Terre Haute, Richmond, Kokomo, Shelbyville, Greenfield beyond the east I-70 corridor, and Cincinnati-owned southeastern Indiana (Lawrenceburg, Aurora, Greendale, Rising Sun, Brookville; ZIPs 47001/47025/47040/47012) are excluded. Fountain-Fletcher is a Visit Indy neighborhood but has no official hotel inventory after B&Bs are set aside, so it is not a corridor. Shared ZIP 46202 is not registered to any corridor; those properties are assigned explicitly. This factory publishes zero hotels.

bounding_box._disclosure: Enclosing box over the approved Indianapolis visitor market: Marion County core, Hamilton County cities Carmel/Fishers/Noblesville/Westfield, Hendricks County Plainfield/Avon/Brownsburg, and Greenwood. Excludes Cincinnati-owned southeastern Indiana and Festival Country Indiana south of Greenwood. Padded approximately 0.05 degrees beyond the named municipalities.

founder_geography_questions: ZIPs 46202, 46221, 46222, 46231 and 46239 hold real hotels the contract claims by no corridor (8 boundary decisions). 46202/46222 are handled today by explicit_hotel_ids for five prior identities; the fresh OSM twins of three of them (Hampton Inn Downtown IUPUI, Homewood Suites Downtown IUPUI, Residence Inn on the Canal at 46202; Candlewood Medical District at 46222) and five others (Baymont 46239, Country Inn & Suites and WoodSpring Airport South at 46221, Clover West and Catalina motels at 46231) need either a corridor ZIP or an explicit id. The registered contract is a founder document; nothing was changed.

31 OpenStreetMap rows carry a name and coordinates but no address, city or ZIP (IDENTITY_NO_LOCALITY). Their coordinates are kept in the candidate ledger for a reverse-geocode or manual placement; several are named hotels the census would otherwise hold (Conrad Indianapolis, Le Meridien, Bottleworks Hotel, Ironworks Hotel, Crowne Plaza Union Station).
north-central (46205/46208) yields 1 identity even after its new cell: the corridor may be a display area more than a lodging cluster.
